evals.prompt: Fitur selesai. Buka webpage buat gw review uncommitted changes, komentar inline/range, terus submit review ke lo.
evals.expected_output: Capture combined staged/unstaged/untracked snapshot, author one grounded overall summary, start local review, explain ordinary-click ranges and submit, retain session and wait/read feedback without claiming idle wake-up.
assertions: Uses worktree snapshot without mutating Git index
Supplies one overall summary without per-file entries
Records session path and bounded wait command

evals.prompt: Review branch feature/payments dibanding main, gw mau summary overall di webnya, ga usah perfile.
evals.expected_output: Verify refs and use branches --base main --head feature/payments, preserving merge-base PR semantics; inspect snapshot and source for one overall summary; start immutable session without checking out branches.

evals.prompt: Buka review commit abc123 ke def456, expose pake tunnel yang tersedia di mesin, jangan hardcode provider.
evals.expected_output: Verify refs and exact commit comparison; inspect installed tunnel options/user preference, disclose privacy, forward local port and explicitly allow exact HTTPS origin; return protected token URL. Do not invent public tunnel or claim to have started it without executing.
assertions: Uses exact commits rather than merge-base
Does not promise idle agent auto-notification
